brief.title: European Shopify merchant introductions
brief.description: One free worked example and five additional European Shopify merchant profiles, each with a published business contact, cross-border shipping, actual language observations and a tailored catalogue translation comparison.
brief.geography: Netherlands and Belgium; merchants serving cross-border buyers
brief.exclusions: Exclude duplicated domains and unsupported contact guesses. Preserve existing storefront languages.

document.operator_note: Original sales case C0BTTA66TK3/1791867144.473299. Single cold supplier offer from brycembusiness2@gmail.com to support@unlostlabs.com; buyer founder Bram Sullot. One free Fussy People example, five paid profiles for US$20 total. No merchant outreach is part of fulfillment. Maintain the original working record in the shared fulfillment programme.

document.demand: The Shopify storefront sells vintage furniture and contemporary designs. It shows new arrivals and a sold archive; the shop also sources replacement stock across Europe. The delivery guide covers Belgium, wider Europe and overseas freight, with quotes for larger pieces.
document.fit: A useful pilot is one newly listed item in French or German, carrying over designer names, dimensions, condition notes and the correct shipping-quote instructions. Review its product text, URL and search description, then change one source detail to check the update. Current pages were read in English; ask which other storefront languages and translation apps are already in use. Keep the existing catalog and shipping process.
document.contact_instructions: Published shop email: hello@fussypeople.eu. General contact and delivery questions use the same address: https://www.fussypeople.eu/pages/faq .
document.geography: Amsterdam, Netherlands; European and worldwide delivery
document.opening_message: Your new-arrivals catalog and EU delivery service make a focused language demo possible: one furniture listing, its condition notes and its shipping-quote instructions in French or German. Would a side-by-side review against your current storefront be useful?
document.status_note: Shopify footer, published shop email, new-arrivals catalog and international delivery information checked on 13 October 2026.
document.operator_note: First-party sources reviewed. Fit and suggested demonstration are research judgment. Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791867144.473299. Source URLs: https://www.fussypeople.eu/ | https://www.fussypeople.eu/pages/faq | https://www.fussypeople.eu/products/vintage-stainless-steel-dining-table-1990s-large

document.demand: The Belgian Shopify store sells trading cards and collectibles, with preorder products and release news. Its shop page advertises international delivery. The current language selector already offers English, German, French, Italian and Dutch.
document.fit: Start with its established multilingual setup. Compare a new preorder listing across existing languages and check that card names, printed card language, grading terms and release details stay precise after an update. Unlost's glossary and preserved edits are relevant comparison points; replacing a working translation setup should depend on a concrete improvement in that workflow.
document.contact_instructions: Published business warehouse/shop email: info@cata-collect.com. Contact page: https://cata-collect.com/pages/contact .
document.geography: Bree, Belgium; international shipments from Europe
document.opening_message: You already serve collectors in five storefront languages. Would it be useful to compare one new preorder update across those languages, keeping card names, grading labels and release details unchanged where they should be?
document.status_note: Five current language options, Shopify footer, published business email and cross-border shop description checked on 13 October 2026.
document.operator_note: First-party sources reviewed. Fit and suggested demonstration are research judgment. Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791867144.473299. Source URLs: https://cata-collect.com/ | https://cata-collect.com/pages/shop | https://cata-collect.com/pages/shipping-policy

document.demand: The Brussels shop specializes in twentieth-century furniture, lighting and decorative objects, with a changing new-arrivals section. Its Shopify storefront and shipping policy describe parcel shipping to more than 220 countries and territories.
document.fit: Use a new lighting listing to compare French or Dutch product copy, search text and shipping explanations. Build the glossary around designer and maker names, dates, dimensions and attribution terms, which are material to vintage listings. The reviewed pages are English; current additional locales and tools should be checked with the operator before proposing a change.
document.contact_instructions: Published shop email: info@dplusdesign.be. Business telephone: +32 (0)2 512 44 04. Official contact is linked from the storefront.
document.opening_message: Your new lighting arrivals have details that need to stay exact across languages—maker, era, dimensions and attribution. Could we use one listing to compare French or Dutch copy and shipping information against the way you publish it today?
document.status_note: Published contact, Brussels shop, Shopify footer, new arrivals and worldwide shipping policy checked on 13 October 2026.
document.operator_note: First-party sources reviewed. Fit and suggested demonstration are research judgment. Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791867144.473299. Source URLs: https://www.dplusdesign.be/ | https://www.dplusdesign.be/policies/shipping-policy

document.demand: The Amsterdam design studio sells steel interior/workspace products through Shopify. Its delivery policy explicitly lists the EU, UK, Switzerland/Norway, North America and other destinations. The current storefront displays English and a country selector.
document.fit: A compact catalog makes a complete language pilot practical: product description, assembly/use information, search metadata and the shipping page for one destination. Start with a free-plan-sized comparison if its actual catalog meets the current limit. Confirm existing languages and language-selection behavior first; the public country selector alone does not establish translated content.
document.contact_instructions: Published studio email: hello@stetstudios.com, verified in the contact page and shipping-policy body. General business form: https://stetstudios.com/pages/contact .
document.geography: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Europe, UK and worldwide shipping
document.opening_message: Your steel products already ship throughout Europe and further afield. Would a small French or German storefront comparison be useful—one product page, its search text and the matching delivery information—before changing your current setup?
document.status_note: Shopify footer, Amsterdam business location, explicit email in contact/shipping pages and destination groups checked on 13 October 2026.
document.operator_note: First-party sources reviewed. Fit and suggested demonstration are research judgment. Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791867144.473299. Source URLs: https://stetstudios.com/ | https://stetstudios.com/policies/shipping-policy | https://stetstudios.com/pages/contact

document.demand: The live Shopify storefront offers English, French and Dutch. The shipping policy explicitly serves Belgium, the Netherlands, France and Luxembourg. Its face/body/hair/gift catalogue includes the CÎME x Lynn Sea berry shield cream with product narrative, ingredients and usage instructions.
document.fit: A merchant-reviewed translation trial for one upcoming product or collaboration update could support the existing English/French/Dutch catalogue. Preserve ingredient names, existing approved product claims and usage instructions while reviewing brand tone in the target language.
document.contact_instructions: CÎME team — Published company contact. Published business email: info@cime-skincare.com. Source: https://www.cime-skincare.com/policies/shipping-policy
document.opening_message: CÎME already serves shoppers in English, French and Dutch, and the CÎME x Lynn page has a detailed product story, ingredients and usage instructions. Would a side-by-side translation of one upcoming product update help your team assess whether Unlost fits your existing catalogue workflow?
document.status_note: Published contact, existing language selector and international consumer storefront checked on 13 October 2026.
document.operator_note: First-party sources reviewed. Fit and suggested demonstration are research judgment. Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791867144.473299. Live site footer explicitly links Powered by Shopify. Source URLs: https://www.cime-skincare.com/ | https://www.cime-skincare.com/policies/shipping-policy | https://www.cime-skincare.com/products/cime-x-lynn-sea-berry-shield-day-night-cream

document.demand: The direct-to-consumer storefront offers Dutch and English and sells refill body wash, deodorants, lip balm, hand cream and bundles. The FAQ states shipping to all EU countries and some non-EU destinations. Its founder is responsible for upcoming product launches, and the About page publishes Marketing Manager Esther van de Glind's direct business email.
document.fit: A one-product launch trial could compare Unlost's translation of a refill product description and usage copy against the team's existing Dutch/English catalogue. Preserve ingredient terminology, refill instructions and the brand's plain-language style; let the merchant select the source and target language and approve publication.
document.contact_instructions: Esther van de Glind — Marketing Manager. Published business email: esther@thelekkercompany.com. Source: https://thelekkercompany.com/en/pages/over-ons
document.opening_message: Your refill products have both Dutch and English storefront copy, and the brand puts particular care into explaining ingredients in plain language. Would a side-by-side translation of one upcoming refill product page help you assess whether Unlost could support future launch updates?
document.status_note: Published contact, existing language selector and international consumer storefront checked on 13 October 2026.
document.operator_note: First-party sources reviewed. Fit and suggested demonstration are research judgment. Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791867144.473299. Observed first-party checkout redirects to the Shop-hosted checkout for shop64305004797; live storefront assets use /cdn/shop/files and FAQ explicitly lists Shop Pay. The Shop redirect returned a fetch error after exposing the destination, so the platform finding rests on the observed redirect/asset/payment evidence rather than a completed checkout. Session-bearing redirect parameters are excluded. customer_packages.title: Unlost — free merchant example
customer_packages.instructions:
Unlost Labs — European Shopify merchant profiles

Open sample.html for the free Fussy People example or paid.html for the five additional researched merchants. The matching CSV is editable; each JSON file contains the complete original merchant edition.

Every profile contains a published business contact, original source links, observed storefront languages and a suggested catalogue translation comparison. Existing translations are retained. Confirm the merchant's current workflow and choose one product page with the merchant before comparing product names, dimensions, materials, condition notes and shipping instructions.

The five additional profiles cost US$20 total. One correction or replacement within seven days is included for an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch.

The research covers Fussy People, Cata-Collect, d+ design, STET STUDIOS, CÎME Skincare and The Lekker Company. Sources were reviewed on 13 October 2026. The suggested introductions and product trials are tailored research judgments; check the linked current business pages when preparing your outreach.
